scenario: A cloud-software company compares two incident-response playbooks across low-complexity, medium-complexity, and high-complexity outages. Leadership prefers Playbook A because its aggregate first-day resolution rate is higher.

data.description: First-day resolution by outage complexity and playbook.

question: (a) Which playbook performs better in each complexity band? (b) If the expected outage mix is 30% low, 40% medium, and 30% high complexity, compute the corrected first-day resolution rate for each playbook. (c) Which playbook should be preferred?

ground_truth.explanation: Playbook B is better in all three bands; aggregate results are distorted by case-mix.

naive_answer: Playbook A is better because its overall resolution rate is higher.
naive_trap: Playbook A handled a much easier incident mix.
